headline: Banks Vigorously Mobilize International Capital
summary: Vietnamese banks are competing for domestic deposits and also turning to international bonds and foreign financial institutions for long-term funding. The article notes this raises requirements for managing exchange rate and maturity risk.
why: Vietnamese banks rely on deposits and funding markets to finance credit growth, so their overseas borrowing affects currency and liquidity exposure.
